title: A sixty-second Field Check teaches the Navigator
items: Take the field check (in the section Guide opens) walks you through seven short steps: the Navigator, looking, walking, opening a building's file, going deeper, the Confidence view, and what to do next.
Each step waits until you actually do it. Skip is always there, and a highlight with the rest of the screen dimmed shows where to look.
If you reload partway through, the check picks up at the same step. You can take it again any time.
